rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Bibliometric data that includes categories describing the research career of people. Each of such categories is characterised by four specific dimensions: the research period considered, the curve of the chosen citation distribution, the slope of such curve, and the order of magnitude of the citation of such research period.
